title: Logging Reliability & Onboarding Rules
summary: Server event logs are less likely to be delayed during busy periods, and onboarding now gives communities more room to share their rules with new members.

highlights.title: More Reliable Server Logs
highlights.description: Server event logs are less likely to be delayed during busy periods, helping moderation and activity updates stay easier to follow.

highlights.title: Longer Onboarding Rules
highlights.description: Server rules in onboarding can now be up to 4,000 characters, making it easier to share complete guidelines with new members.

items: Server event log delivery reliability during busy periods
Onboarding rules support for up to 4,000 characters
